sec17-card-sec17-R08.teaching_text: Parking lamps belong strictly on stationary parked cars, never for driving through twilight.

sec17-card-sec17-F36.question_text: How does headlight reach cap your safe driving speed after dark?
sec17-card-sec17-F36.teaching_text: Outrunning your beam cone means any stalled car or elk emerging from darkness is already unmissable.

sec17-card-sec17-F37.question_text: Which headlight beam setting belongs on city or town streets?
sec17-card-sec17-F37.teaching_text: Streetlights and steady urban traffic make high beams unnecessary and blinding to neighbors.

sec17-card-sec17-F38.question_text: On an open highway at night, within what oncoming distance are high beams prohibited?
sec17-card-sec17-F38.teaching_text: Dropping to low beams by five hundred feet keeps approaching drivers from going night-blind.

sec17-card-sec17-F39.question_text: Why must you switch from high beams to low beams whenever meeting oncoming traffic?
sec17-card-sec17-F39.teaching_text: A dazzled oncoming driver can drift straight across the yellow centerline toward your fender.

sec17-card-sec17-F40.question_text: Within what distance behind another vehicle must you switch from high beams to low beams?
sec17-card-sec17-F40.teaching_text: High beams inside two hundred feet bounce straight off rear and side mirrors into the lead driver's eyes.

sec17-card-sec17-R06.question_text: Pair Arizona's oncoming high-beam dimming distance with its following high-beam dimming distance?
sec17-card-sec17-R06.teaching_text: Lock in five hundred feet nose-to-nose and two hundred feet bumper-to-tail for test day.
sec17-card-sec17-R06.must_match_memory_hook: Five hundred oncoming, two hundred behind

visual_sync.text_span: Five hundred oncoming, two hundred behind

sec17-card-sec17-R07.question_text: Contrast where low beams belong with the sole setting where high beams are appropriate?
sec17-card-sec17-R07.teaching_text: High beams serve dark open highways free of nearby cars, while towns and weather need low beams.
sec17-card-sec17-R07.must_match_memory_hook: Town storms low, open highways high

visual_sync.text_span: Town storms low, open highways high

sec17-card-sec17-F41.question_text: Where should you direct your eyes if an oncoming driver forgets to dim high beams?
sec17-card-sec17-F41.teaching_text: Using the white right-edge line preserves night vision while peripheral sight tracks the passing car.

sec17-card-sec17-F42.question_text: How long do you maintain that right-edge-and-ahead glance routine against bright oncoming lights?
sec17-card-sec17-F42.teaching_text: Looking back into the lamps just before passing ruins dark adaptation for the dark stretch beyond.

sec17-card-sec17-F43.question_text: What is highway hypnosis, and what nickname describes it?
sec17-card-sec17-F43.teaching_text: Monotonous desert miles lull staring eyes into a daze that freezes reaction time.

sec17-card-sec17-F44.question_text: What immediate action should you take anytime you start feeling tired on a trip?
sec17-card-sec17-F44.teaching_text: Pushing even ten extra miles while nodding off turns micro-sleeps into high-speed rollovers.

sec17-card-sec17-F45.question_text: Which two simple cabin adjustments help fend off highway hypnosis?
sec17-card-sec17-F45.teaching_text: Cool outside air and changing audio stimulation break up monotonous road hum.

sec17-card-sec17-F46.question_text: How often does Arizona recommend stopping to walk and stretch on long highway trips?
sec17-card-sec17-F46.teaching_text: Stepping out every hour gets blood flowing and resets visual alertness before trance sets in.

sec17-card-sec17-R12.question_text: Combine Arizona's three defenses against highway hypnosis on long drives?
sec17-card-sec17-R12.teaching_text: Combining hourly leg stretches with fresh cabin air and genuine rest keeps long desert stretches sharp.

sec17-card-sec17-F47.question_text: Why must defensive awareness stay switched on at every hour of the day or night?
sec17-card-sec17-F47.teaching_text: Wrong-way vehicles close at combined double highway speed, rewarding drivers scanning far ahead.

sec17-card-sec17-F48.question_text: How does leaving generous following room protect you from a sudden wrong-way driver ahead?
sec17-card-sec17-F48.teaching_text: Tailgaters get blindsided head-on the instant a lead SUV dodges an oncoming wrong-way car.

sec17-card-sec17-F49.question_text: In which freeway lanes do wrong-way drivers usually travel, and how do they enter the highway?
sec17-card-sec17-F49.teaching_text: Confused drivers enter backward up right-side exit ramps and hug their perceived right lane, which is your fast left lane.

sec17-card-sec17-F50.question_text: Why are a wrong-way driver's steering moves so unpredictable?
sec17-card-sec17-F50.teaching_text: Intoxicated or disoriented drivers often swerve erratically across lanes rather than steering smoothly.

sec17-card-sec17-F57.question_text: What driver condition causes the majority of wrong-way freeway collisions?
sec17-card-sec17-F57.teaching_text: Alcohol and drug impairment overwhelmingly drive fatal head-on freeway collisions across Arizona.

sec17-card-sec17-R10.question_text: Why must you watch both right-side off-ramps and the far-left HOV lane for wrong-way cars?
sec17-card-sec17-R10.teaching_text: Knowing both the entry point and the cruising lane helps you stay clear of late-night fast lanes.

sec17-card-sec17-F51.question_text: What is your immediate pedal move if headlights come straight at you on a divided highway?
sec17-card-sec17-F51.teaching_text: Shedding speed immediately softens closing energy while keeping tires rolling for an evasive steer.

sec17-card-sec17-F52.question_text: What quick check precedes steering away from an oncoming wrong-way vehicle?
sec17-card-sec17-F52.teaching_text: Confirming nobody rides beside your right door lets you dodge cleanly without causing a multi-car spin.

sec17-card-sec17-F53.question_text: When and how should you report a wrong-way vehicle to authorities?
sec17-card-sec17-F53.teaching_text: Get clear and parked safely first, then call nine-one-one immediately so troopers and sign boards activate.

sec17-card-sec17-F54.question_text: How do Arizona highway officials warn motorists once a wrong-way vehicle is reported?
sec17-card-sec17-F54.teaching_text: Electronic freeway gantries light up upstream along that corridor to clear drivers out of harm's way.

sec17-card-sec17-F55.question_text: What action should you take as soon as an overhead board displays a wrong-way driver alert?
sec17-card-sec17-F55.teaching_text: Getting off the freeway at the next ramp removes you completely from the oncoming car's corridor.

sec17-card-sec17-R11.question_text: Contrast your response to spotting oncoming headlights versus reading an overhead wrong-way alert?
sec17-card-sec17-R11.teaching_text: Visual contact demands instant throttle lift and clear-side evasion, while gantry warnings call for an orderly exit.

sec17-card-sec17-F56.question_text: Which two personal pledges keep you and friends from causing distracted or wrong-way tragedies?
sec17-card-sec17-F56.teaching_text: Refusing to drive distracted or impaired—and taking keys from impaired friends—stops crashes before engines start.

sec21-card-sec21-F01.question_text: Why must you submit any MVD hearing request within the statutory deadline?
sec21-card-sec21-F01.teaching_text: Waiting past the legal filing window can permanently forfeit your right to challenge an MVD order.

sec21-card-sec21-F02.question_text: What scope of guidance can the Executive Hearing Office provide, and whom should you ask for specific legal advice?
sec21-card-sec21-F02.teaching_text: Hearing staff can explain general procedures, whereas tailored legal strategy belongs to a licensed attorney.

sec21-card-sec21-F03.question_text: When can skids, tire blowouts, or sudden mechanical failures strike on the road?
sec21-card-sec21-F03.teaching_text: Because tire, brake, or traction emergencies give zero calendar warning, rehearse recovery moves ahead of time.

sec21-card-sec21-F04.question_text: What routine maintenance habit lowers your risk of suffering a tire blowout?
sec21-card-sec21-F04.teaching_text: Underinflated tires flex and overheat at highway speeds—routine gauge checks catch low pressure before sidewalls fail.

sec21-card-sec21-F05.question_text: What is your immediate steering-wheel duty the instant a tire blows out?
sec21-card-sec21-F05.teaching_text: A blown tire tugs hard toward its corner—clamping both hands firmly keeps the vehicle tracking straight.

sec21-card-sec21-F06.question_text: While rolling through a fresh tire blowout, how do you handle the accelerator and brake pedals?
sec21-card-sec21-F06.teaching_text: Touching the brakes at speed on a blown tire can spin the vehicle—smoothly lift off the gas instead.

sec21-card-sec21-F07.question_text: After a blowout, how slow should the car coast before you signal, pull off the roadway, and brake?
sec21-card-sec21-F07.teaching_text: Hold straight in your lane until rolling speed drops to nearly a crawl, then signal, pull off, and brake.

sec21-card-sec21-R01.question_text: In Arizona's blowout sequence, at what exact stage do you finally touch the brake pedal?
sec21-card-sec21-R01.teaching_text: Arizona draws a sharp line—zero braking during high-speed roll-down, applying brakes only once nearly stopped and pulling off.

sec21-card-sec21-F08.question_text: What system fault causes most motor-vehicle fires?
sec21-card-sec21-F08.teaching_text: Chafed wiring or shorted battery circuits spark the majority of under-hood and cabin vehicle fires.

sec21-card-sec21-F09.question_text: In order, what four life-safety steps must you take if your vehicle catches fire?
sec21-card-sec21-F09.teaching_text: Pull off immediately, kill the ignition to cut live current and fuel pumps, move everyone away, and dial nine-one-one.

sec21-card-sec21-F10.question_text: Which rated type of portable fire extinguisher is best suited for motor-vehicle fires?
sec21-card-sec21-F10.teaching_text: An ABC-rated dry chemical canister handles upholstery, flammable liquids, and energized wiring fires all in one.

sec21-card-sec21-F11.question_text: Why must you never pour water onto burning gasoline?
sec21-card-sec21-F11.teaching_text: Gasoline floats right atop water, so splashing water carries flaming fuel outward instead of putting it out.

sec21-card-sec21-F12.question_text: If you don't have a fire extinguisher handy, which three items can help smother small vehicle flames?
sec21-card-sec21-F12.teaching_text: Starving small flames of oxygen works with dense materials like a heavy blanket, thick coat, or roadside sand.

sec21-card-sec21-F13.question_text: What is the rule whenever a vehicle fire looks like it might grow beyond your control?
sec21-card-sec21-F13.teaching_text: No car is worth burns or toxic smoke—retreat to a safe distance and let firefighters handle growing flames.

sec21-card-sec21-R02.question_text: Which tools safely fight a small vehicle fire, and what liquid must never touch burning gasoline?
sec21-card-sec21-R02.teaching_text: Keep an ABC dry chemical unit—or smother with heavy fabric or sand—and never splash water on fuel.

sec21-card-sec21-F14.question_text: What mechanical trouble does white steam billowing from under your hood usually indicate?
sec21-card-sec21-F14.teaching_text: Billowing hood steam signals boiling coolant inside an overheated radiator or burst cooling hose.

sec21-card-sec21-F15.question_text: What two immediate steps should you take as soon as your engine overheats?
sec21-card-sec21-F15.teaching_text: Continuing to run an overheated engine warps cylinder heads—pull safely off the road and kill ignition immediately.

sec21-card-sec21-F16.question_text: On an overheated car, how do you handle the hood versus the radiator cap—and why?
sec21-card-sec21-F16.teaching_text: Prop the hood open to vent heat, yet never twist a hot pressurized radiator cap or scalding steam erupts.

sec21-card-sec21-F17.question_text: In desert Arizona driving, what spare fluid should you pack for the radiator, and when may you add it?
sec21-card-sec21-F17.teaching_text: Wait until the engine block cools down completely before opening the system and pouring reserve water in.

sec21-card-sec21-R03.question_text: With an overheated engine, how do the hood, radiator cap, and spare water work together?
sec21-card-sec21-R03.teaching_text: Air cools the open bay while the cap stays sealed tight, and spare water goes in only once cold.

sec21-card-sec21-F18.question_text: If your engine stalls mid-turn and power steering drops out, how do you steer to safety?
sec21-card-sec21-F18.teaching_text: Manual steering linkage still works—muscle the heavy wheel with both hands to complete your turn and pull right.

sec21-card-sec21-F19.question_text: After losing engine power and power steering, how must you press power brakes to stop?
sec21-card-sec21-F19.teaching_text: Without engine vacuum boost, power-brake pedals stiffen dramatically and demand much heavier leg force to stop.

sec21-card-sec21-R06.question_text: When an engine dies mid-turn, how do your hands on the wheel and your foot on power brakes adapt?
sec21-card-sec21-R06.teaching_text: Loss of power assist hits both controls—use two firm hands to finish steering and extra-hard pressure on power brakes.

sec21-card-sec21-F20.question_text: If your headlights suddenly go dark at night, which switch should you try first?
sec21-card-sec21-F20.teaching_text: High and low beams often run on separate filaments or relays, so flipping the dimmer stalk can restore light immediately.

sec21-card-sec21-F21.question_text: If toggling the high-low dimmer doesn't bring headlights back, what switch action comes second?
sec21-card-sec21-F21.teaching_text: Clicking the main headlight knob on and off several times can reset a tripped breaker or dirty contact.

sec21-card-sec21-F22.question_text: If headlights refuse to come back on at all, which backup lights do you use as you pull off?
sec21-card-sec21-F22.teaching_text: Use parking lights, hazard flashers, or turn signals to mark your car while guiding immediately onto the shoulder.

sec21-card-sec21-F23.question_text: On a vehicle equipped with anti-lock brakes, should you ever pump the brake pedal?
sec21-card-sec21-F23.teaching_text: ABS computers pulse wheel pressure automatically—pumping the pedal defeats the system and lengthens stops.

sec21-card-sec21-F24.question_text: If regular brakes fail on a vehicle without anti-lock brakes, what pedal technique should you try first?
sec21-card-sec21-F24.teaching_text: Fast repeated strokes on conventional hydraulic brakes can build enough residual line pressure to slow the car.

sec21-card-sec21-R04.question_text: How does proper pedal technique differ between working anti-lock brakes and failed conventional brakes?
sec21-card-sec21-R04.teaching_text: Keep the contrast sharp—anti-lock brakes are never pumped, whereas failed non-ABS brakes get rapid pumping to build pressure.

sec21-card-sec21-F25.question_text: When main brakes fail completely, how must you apply the parking brake and why hold its release?
sec21-card-sec21-F25.teaching_text: Pulling gradually while holding the release lets you ease off instantly if rear wheels lock into a skid.

sec21-card-sec21-R07.question_text: During brake failure, what skid hazard explains keeping your thumb or hand on the parking-brake release?
sec21-card-sec21-R07.teaching_text: Parking brakes clamp only the rear axle—ratcheting them locked without holding the release spins the rear end.

sec21-card-sec21-F26.question_text: Alongside pedal and parking-brake work, what gearshift and scanning steps help stop a car with failed brakes?
sec21-card-sec21-F26.teaching_text: Shifting into a lower gear uses engine compression drag to shed speed while you aim for a safe stopping spot.

sec21-card-sec21-F27.question_text: If you're stopped at a sign or light and spot a car closing fast in your mirror, what can help?
sec21-card-sec21-F27.teaching_text: Moving ahead a few extra feet when clear gives the late-braking driver behind you precious stopping room.

sec21-card-sec21-F28.question_text: How do you brace your body and time your brake foot right before an unavoidable rear-end impact?
sec21-card-sec21-F28.teaching_text: Press back between wheel and seat, then let off the brake a split second before impact to soften jolt.

sec21-card-sec21-F29.question_text: Which three actions warn an oncoming driver drifting into your lane toward a head-on crash?
sec21-card-sec21-F29.teaching_text: Shedding speed immediately buys time while flashing headlights and blasting the horn wake up a distracted or drowsy driver.

sec21-card-sec21-F30.question_text: If an oncoming vehicle keeps coming in your lane, where should you steer to escape?
sec21-card-sec21-F30.teaching_text: Never swerve left into the other lane where the oncoming driver may recover—escape right onto the shoulder.

sec21-card-sec21-F31.question_text: If a head-on collision cannot be escaped altogether, what is your steering goal?
sec21-card-sec21-F31.teaching_text: Angling toward a glancing blow or softer roadside brush cuts crash forces dramatically compared with bumper-to-bumper impact.

sec21-card-sec21-R05.question_text: How does your final-moment action before a rear-end hit contrast with facing a head-on threat?
sec21-card-sec21-R05.teaching_text: Before rear impact you release the brake an instant early, whereas facing head-on danger you slow and take the shoulder.

sec21-card-sec21-F32.question_text: What single habit gives you the strongest protection against injury if a crash happens?
sec21-card-sec21-F32.teaching_text: Airbags and crumple zones assume you're held in place—wearing your seat belt every ride tops every crash defense.

sec21-card-sec21-F33.question_text: When two road hazards appear together and cannot be separated in time, what does compromise mean?
sec21-card-sec21-F33.teaching_text: When you must pass two simultaneous hazards, shift your lane cushion away from whichever threat is greatest or likeliest.

sec21-card-sec21-F34.question_text: With oncoming traffic on your left and a child bicycling on your right, where do you position your car—and why?
sec21-card-sec21-F34.teaching_text: Because a child on a bicycle is far likelier to wobble unexpectedly than oncoming cars, give the child wider room.

sec21-card-sec21-R09.question_text: Why does Arizona's compromise rule give extra space to a bicycling child over oncoming cars?
sec21-card-sec21-R09.teaching_text: Compromise favors the hazard likeliest to shift into your path—making a wobbling young rider the priority buffer.

sec21-card-sec21-F35.question_text: Which surface condition and pedal mistake commonly throw a vehicle into a skid?
sec21-card-sec21-F35.teaching_text: Slick road surfaces or slamming the brakes too abruptly breaks tire grip and starts a slide.

sec21-card-sec21-F36.question_text: Once your vehicle enters a skid, what must you do with the brake pedal—and why?
sec21-card-sec21-F36.teaching_text: Staying on the brake keeps tires locked and sliding—releasing the pedal lets wheels roll and regain directional bite.

sec21-card-sec21-F37.question_text: Which direction do you turn the steering wheel immediately when your car skids?
sec21-card-sec21-F37.teaching_text: Turn promptly toward the lane path you want to travel, which matches the direction the rear is skidding.

sec21-card-sec21-F38.question_text: What steering follow-up prevents fishtailing as your skidding vehicle begins to straighten out?
sec21-card-sec21-F38.teaching_text: Waiting too long as tires bite whips the tail the opposite way—turn back promptly and keep fine-tuning straight.

sec21-card-sec21-R08.question_text: What two linked steering motions bring a skidding vehicle cleanly back onto its normal path?
sec21-card-sec21-R08.teaching_text: Steer into the skid toward your intended lane first, then counter-steer back promptly as the chassis straightens.

sec21-card-sec21-F39.question_text: Which three types of roadway debris show up frequently on Arizona highways?
sec21-card-sec21-F39.teaching_text: Desert heat sheds truck tire treads, loose truck beds drop cargo, and monsoon storms wash rocks onto pavement.

sec21-card-sec21-F40.question_text: How do many serious Arizona road-debris crashes actually happen compared with driving straight over small debris?
sec21-card-sec21-F40.teaching_text: Yanking the wheel at freeway speed loses control and sends cars off-road, whereas rolling over minor debris hurts far less.

sec21-card-sec21-F41.question_text: Why should you mentally rehearse debris scenarios while scanning ahead on clean pavement?
sec21-card-sec21-F41.teaching_text: Sudden debris leaves barely a heartbeat to react—knowing your surrounding lanes beforehand prevents fatal panic swerves.

sec21-card-sec21-R11.question_text: Why isn't swerving hard to dodge road debris always the safest move?
sec21-card-sec21-R11.teaching_text: High-speed swerves routinely cause deadly run-off-road wrecks when straddling or rolling over small debris is far less severe.

sec21-card-sec21-F42.question_text: How do wild animals and ranch livestock end up on Arizona roadways?
sec21-card-sec21-F42.teaching_text: Wild game darts out anywhere unannounced, while cattle or horses wander out through unlatched ranch gates or cut fences.

sec21-card-sec21-F43.question_text: What braking and steering response applies when an animal is already standing in your roadway?
sec21-card-sec21-F43.teaching_text: Shed as much speed as safely possible and steer around a direct hit only within controlled limits.

sec21-card-sec21-F44.question_text: Why must you keep off your horn when passing an animal standing near—not yet on—the road?
sec21-card-sec21-F44.teaching_text: Blasting the horn spooks calm roadside deer or cattle and can make them bolt straight across your hood.

sec21-card-sec21-F45.question_text: Whom should you call when loose livestock or an animal on the highway endangers traffic?
sec21-card-sec21-F45.teaching_text: Dialing nine-one-one dispatches officers to clear loose cattle or large animals before another driver hits them at speed.

sec21-card-sec21-R10.question_text: How does handling an animal already in your lane differ from passing one standing beside the shoulder?
sec21-card-sec21-R10.teaching_text: Animals on pavement call for controlled braking and steering, whereas roadside animals call for silence—no startling horn.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.question_text: Which windows and doors must operate properly on the vehicle you bring to an Arizona road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.teaching_text: Examiners will not climb into a cabin with a jammed passenger latch or stuck front side glass.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.question_text: Which two current vehicle documents must you show before starting your Arizona road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.teaching_text: Expired tags or missing liability coverage stops your road drive at the check-in desk.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.question_text: Starting with which model year must a road-test vehicle have properly fastened and adjusted seat belts?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.teaching_text: Every car built from nineteen seventy-two onward needs working belts worn snugly by both driver and examiner.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.question_text: Why doesn't Arizona's road-test seat-belt rule say every vehicle ever built?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.teaching_text: Federal belt mandates phased in by model year, pinning Arizona's road-test belt cutoff at nineteen seventy-two.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.question_text: Are auto-drive or parking-assist features allowed during your Arizona road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.teaching_text: Examiners test your manual steering, braking, and spatial judgment—never automated parking or lane-keeping tech.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.question_text: What company requirement applies to the liability policy covering any motor vehicle driven on Arizona roads?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.teaching_text: Coverage written by an out-of-state carrier unlicensed in Arizona fails state financial-responsibility rules.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.question_text: Which state's policy rating must cover a vehicle driven primarily on Arizona roads?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.teaching_text: Keeping a former state's policy on a car living in Phoenix leaves your MVD insurance record invalid.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.question_text: Why isn't holding just any active auto policy enough to satisfy Arizona's insurance law?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.teaching_text: Both halves must hold—an Arizona-licensed insurer writing an Arizona-based policy for cars driven mostly here.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.question_text: What are Arizona's three minimum passenger-vehicle liability limits for one injury, two-plus injuries, and property damage?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.teaching_text: Watch that third number closely—Arizona requires fifteen thousand dollars for property alongside twenty-five and fifty for injuries.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.question_text: How do Arizona's bodily-injury liability floors split by headcount compared with the property-damage floor?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.teaching_text: Single-victim injury starts at twenty-five thousand, multi-victim doubles to fifty, and property sits at fifteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.question_text: What should you verify about the VIN your insurer transmits—and what if one digit differs from your registration?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.teaching_text: A single mistyped VIN character makes MVD's computer think your car is uninsured until your carrier resubmits.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.question_text: When must current insurance proof ride inside your vehicle, and when do officers demand it?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.teaching_text: Leaving active proof on your kitchen counter still earns a citation at a traffic stop or collision scene.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.question_text: Which three policy events do insurers report electronically to MVD, and how does MVD react to an inactive notice?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.teaching_text: Because insurers feed MVD directly, dropping coverage triggers an official MVD inquiry notice automatically.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.question_text: Which credentials can MVD suspend if you fail to maintain proper Arizona insurance with a matching VIN?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.teaching_text: Skipping an MVD insurance notice can ground both your car's plates and your personal driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.question_text: Does an Arizona insurance lapse or wrong VIN threaten only your vehicle registration, or your driver license too?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.teaching_text: Many drivers assume only vehicle tags get suspended, missing that MVD can pull their driver license too.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.question_text: Which tool on AZMVDNow lets you verify the exact insurance policy MVD currently shows on file?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.teaching_text: Checking Manage Insurance online confirms your insurer transmitted the right policy and VIN before problems start.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.question_text: What is the National Driver Register, and when does Arizona query it?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.teaching_text: Every Arizona license application runs through that national database to catch suspensions hiding in other states.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.question_text: What happens to your Arizona license application if the National Driver Register flags unresolved actions in another state?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.teaching_text: You must clear unpaid tickets or suspensions in your old state before Arizona will issue a card.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.question_text: What happens if MVD discovers you gave false information on your license application?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.teaching_text: Hiding an out-of-state suspension or faking residency details gets an issued Arizona license canceled.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.question_text: How does a National Driver Register hit differ in outcome from lying on an Arizona license application?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.teaching_text: Database holds stop MVD from issuing a card upfront, whereas discovered application fraud cancels an issued card.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.question_text: How soon after meeting any Arizona residency trigger must you obtain an Arizona license and registration?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.teaching_text: Unlike states offering thirty- or sixty-day grace windows, Arizona mandates switching right away upon becoming a resident.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.question_text: Which Arizona employment and child school-enrollment situations trigger immediate residency—and what job is exempt?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.teaching_text: Taking a regular Arizona job or enrolling kids without non-resident tuition triggers residency, except seasonal farm work.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.question_text: Which single type of paid work inside Arizona does NOT make you an Arizona resident for licensing?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.teaching_text: Harvest workers following seasonal crops across states are carved out of Arizona's employment residency trigger.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.question_text: Which two commercial office or transport activities establish Arizona residency for vehicle and licensing rules?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.teaching_text: Running an Arizona office that bases vehicles locally—or moving goods or passengers within Arizona—triggers state rules.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.question_text: How do state occupational licenses or resident-rate tuition payments affect your Arizona driver-license status?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.teaching_text: Claiming resident benefits—like in-state tuition or an Arizona state license—simultaneously makes you a resident for MVD.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.question_text: Spending how many total months inside Arizona during one calendar year makes you a resident regardless of permanent home?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.teaching_text: Crossing the seven-month mark in a calendar year triggers Arizona residency even if your main house sits elsewhere.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.question_text: Do your seven months in Arizona have to run back-to-back in a row to trigger residency?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.teaching_text: Splitting four winter months and three fall months in the same calendar year still totals seven and triggers residency.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.question_text: What does registering to vote in Arizona do to your driver-license obligation?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.teaching_text: Joining Arizona's voter rolls declares state residency, triggering the immediate requirement to hold an Arizona license.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.question_text: When does an out-of-state college student stay a non-resident in Arizona—even while working a local job?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.teaching_text: Carrying at least seven semester hours as an out-of-state student shields you from residency even with campus or local paychecks.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.question_text: Which rule wins when an out-of-state student taking eight semester hours picks up a part-time job in Tempe?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.teaching_text: Normally any non-farm job triggers residency, yet full-load out-of-state student status specifically overrides employment.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.question_text: Is filling out the voter-registration section on an Arizona license or ID application mandatory?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.teaching_text: MVD bundles voter signup onto the credential application for convenience, never as a condition of driving.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.question_text: How does MVD protect privacy whether you decline voter registration or choose to register?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.teaching_text: Declining stays private, and completed voter forms remain confidential and restricted strictly to election-roll administration.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.question_text: What level of crime is submitting false voter registration information in Arizona?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.teaching_text: Signing untrue citizenship, age, or residency claims on a voter form is prosecuted as a Class six felony.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.question_text: Which three age, citizenship, and residency requirements must you meet to register to vote in Arizona?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.teaching_text: Every Arizona voter must hold U.S. citizenship, live in Arizona, and reach eighteen by the next General Election.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.question_text: Can a seventeen-year-old register to vote in Arizona if they turn eighteen on the date of the next General Election?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.teaching_text: Arizona measures the age-eighteen requirement on the upcoming General Election day rather than the day you apply.

sec02-card-sec02-F27.question_text: Which two legal or court statuses disqualify someone from registering to vote in Arizona?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.teaching_text: A felony conviction bars voting unless civil rights were restored, as does a court adjudication of incompetence.

sec02-card-sec02-F28.question_text: Aside from the license application itself, what two other MVD channels let you register to vote?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.teaching_text: Voters can register online at AZMVDNow dot gov or pick up a standalone voter form inside MVD lobbies.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.question_text: How many days before an election must you register to vote in it, and what is the fee?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.teaching_text: Voter registration is always free, yet missing the twenty-nine-day pre-election cutoff leaves you off that ballot's roll.

sec02-card-sec02-F30.question_text: What voter-registration step is required every time you move to a new Arizona address?
sec02-card-sec02-F30.teaching_text: Precinct ballots tie directly to your street address, so moving requires submitting a fresh voter registration.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.question_text: What pre-election day count and post-move rule govern keeping your Arizona ballot eligibility active?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.teaching_text: Pair both voter habits—register at least twenty-nine days before election day and re-register whenever you move.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.question_text: Which donor registry can you join directly by checking a box on your Arizona license or ID application?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.teaching_text: Checking that single application box enrolls you as an organ and tissue donor on Arizona's registry.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.question_text: Beyond the paper application box, what three other ways can you join Arizona's organ and tissue donor registry?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.teaching_text: Say yes verbally at MVD or third-party counters, click online at AZMVDNow, or enroll at DonateLifeAZ dot org.

sec02-card-sec02-F33.question_text: What optional health alert can be printed on an Arizona license for first responders?
sec02-card-sec02-F33.teaching_text: Paramedics checking your wallet after a crash spot that medical indicator for conditions needing urgent care.

sec02-card-sec02-F34.question_text: Which three signed medical or legal documents qualify you to add the medical condition indicator to your license?
sec02-card-sec02-F34.teaching_text: Self-reporting never puts the code on your card—MVD requires signed clinical paperwork or your written healthcare directive.

sec02-card-sec02-F35.question_text: What federal identification number must you prove under state and federal law when applying for an Arizona license?
sec02-card-sec02-F35.teaching_text: Both Arizona and federal statutes require applicants to verify a valid Social Security number during licensing.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.question_text: How does Arizona's medical condition indicator differ from Social Security number proof on a license application?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.teaching_text: You request the medical alert voluntarily with doctor paperwork, whereas proving a valid SSN is required by law.

sec01-card-sec01-F01.question_text: If MVD revokes, suspends, or cancels your license, which two fees may you owe to get back on the road?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.teaching_text: Budgeting only for the reinstatement charge leaves you short when MVD also collects a fresh application fee.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.question_text: Does paying a single reinstatement fee cover everything owed after an Arizona revocation, suspension, or cancellation?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.teaching_text: Watch for questions implying reinstatement alone settles your tab—a new application fee stacks right beside it.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.question_text: What fees does MVD assess for an abandoned vehicle—including on federal land—and for a bounced check?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.teaching_text: Leaving a broken-down car sitting hits five hundred dollars—or six hundred on federal land—while bad checks add twenty-five.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.question_text: Beyond cash, which three payment forms do most MVD offices accept, and what payee name goes on checks?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.teaching_text: Personal checks are missing from that list—write cashier's checks or money orders payable to Motor Vehicle Division.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.question_text: Which online portal should you check before driving to MVD, and which three applications can you start there?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.teaching_text: Starting your ID, license, or title paperwork online at AZMVDNow dot gov cuts lobby waiting time.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.question_text: Which three in-person MVD appointments do you schedule through the AZMVDNow portal?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.teaching_text: Reserving your road drive, Travel credential visit, or license renewal slot online beats walking in cold.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.question_text: On which monthly and post-holiday days are MVD lobbies busiest, and when do most offices stay shut until noon?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.teaching_text: Avoiding the opening and closing edges of the month—plus second-Wednesday mornings—spares you crowded lobby lines.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.question_text: Which two advantages come from bringing your valid out-of-state driver license to an Arizona MVD visit?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.teaching_text: Handing over your current state card counts toward secondary identification and can waive written or road testing.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.question_text: Alongside required personal ID, which four vehicle items or numbers should you bring to MVD?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.teaching_text: Bringing your old title, registration, license plates, and seventeen-character VIN finishes both driver and car tasks together.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.question_text: Does presenting an out-of-state driver license let you leave your primary required identification at home?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.teaching_text: Your old state plastic waives testing and covers secondary ID, yet primary identity documents remain mandatory.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.question_text: Under Arizona statute twenty-eight three-one-five-three D, what must every applicant prove before MVD issues or renews a card?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.teaching_text: State law bars MVD counters from issuing or renewing licenses or IDs without verified lawful presence.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.question_text: Does Arizona verify authorized federal presence only on your first license application, or at renewals too?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.teaching_text: Do not assume lawful-presence verification is one-and-done—the statute gates renewals alongside brand-new credentials.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.question_text: What caution does MVD give applicants regarding its acceptable identification list?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.teaching_text: Checking current document lists online right before your visit prevents surprises from unannounced policy updates.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.question_text: Within how many days must you notify Arizona MVD after changing your name or residential address?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.teaching_text: Letting ten days slip past after moving or changing your legal name puts you in violation of state law.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.question_text: Does Arizona grant more time to report a legal name change than a street address change?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.teaching_text: Neither update gets extra breathing room—both name and address changes share the exact ten-day rule.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.question_text: Which two real-world problems hit drivers who fail to report a name or address change to MVD?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.teaching_text: Critical registration or suspension mail goes to your old mailbox while roadside stops can bring a ticket.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.question_text: Which five personal details verify an online address update at AZMVDNow?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.teaching_text: Have your license number, birth date, new zip-coded street address, and final four Social Security digits handy.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.question_text: Does filing your new address with MVD automatically mail you a reprinted card—or how do you get one?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.teaching_text: Reporting satisfies the ten-day law in MVD's computer, while displaying the new street on plastic costs a replacement.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.question_text: Right after you file an online address change, what address still shows on the card in your wallet?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.teaching_text: Your MVD computer file updates immediately, whereas your physical plastic stays unchanged unless you purchase a replacement.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.question_text: Because Arizona MVD links customer records, which files update together when you submit a single address change?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.teaching_text: Unlike states that split driver and car files, Arizona updates your credential and every car where you're first owner.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.question_text: Where must you go to record a legal name change, and what two sets of identification are required?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.teaching_text: Agents at MVD or authorized third-party driver-license counters inspect documents bridging both your old and new names.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.question_text: How does Arizona's filing channel for an address change contrast with filing a legal name change?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.teaching_text: Moves finish from your couch on AZMVDNow, whereas name changes require showing dual-name paperwork at an office.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.question_text: What agency's records must match your new name before MVD prints a replacement license?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.teaching_text: Updating Social Security first prevents MVD's automated verification check from rejecting your replacement license.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.question_text: When are military service members stationed in Arizona exempt from being treated as Arizona residents?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.teaching_text: Qualifying active-duty personnel stationed on Arizona bases keep home-state status under federal relief law.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.question_text: How does the active-duty Relief Act residency exemption differ from Arizona's post-discharge military rule?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.teaching_text: Active service keeps you non-resident indefinitely, whereas military discharge starts a conditional ninety-day work limit.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.question_text: For how many days after military discharge may a former service member work in Arizona using an outside license?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.teaching_text: That ninety-day bridge applies strictly to qualifying employment rather than unconditional permanent driving.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.question_text: Which three license, vehicle-class, and employer rules unlock that ninety-day post-discharge work allowance?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.teaching_text: Missing even one—such as driving a heavy rig or working for an Arizona-only shop—cancels the ninety-day allowance.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.question_text: Does Arizona's ninety-day post-discharge rule give every newly arrived civilian ninety days to switch licenses?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.teaching_text: Never confuse this narrow discharged-veteran employment rule with general newcomer residency, which triggers immediately.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.question_text: Who qualifies to have VETERAN printed on the front of an Arizona license, permit, or ID?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.teaching_text: Both honorably discharged U.S. veterans and currently serving active-duty members qualify for front-of-card recognition.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.question_text: Who qualifies to have NATIVE AMERICAN printed on the front of an Arizona credential?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.teaching_text: The tribe must be both federally recognized and located in Arizona, with verified tribal enrollment.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.question_text: How does eligibility for Arizona's VETERAN front designation differ from its NATIVE AMERICAN designation?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.teaching_text: One honors U.S. veterans and active-duty troops while the other requires enrollment in a federally recognized Arizona tribe.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.question_text: What three application, photo, and cost steps apply when adding VETERAN or NATIVE AMERICAN to your card?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.teaching_text: Adding a front-of-card designation reprints your credential with a fresh portrait under normal transaction fees.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.question_text: What are the two ways—online versus form forty-six four-four-one-six—to obtain your Arizona driving or motor vehicle record?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.teaching_text: Download records at AZMVDNow or bring form forty-six four-four-one-six with photo ID to MVD or third-party counters.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.question_text: Where do you book an Arizona road test, and why check multiple MVD locations when scheduling?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.teaching_text: Checking neighboring MVD branches on AZMVDNow uncovers earlier openings and ensures you drive upon arrival.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.question_text: Does holding a confirmed AZMVDNow appointment guarantee your road test will run that day?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.teaching_text: Flash-flood monsoons, dust storms, or extreme heat safety hazards can halt road testing despite your reservation.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.question_text: Which two environmental or operational hazards cause MVD to pause road testing?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.teaching_text: Examiners pause outdoor road evaluations whenever severe Arizona weather or unsafe traffic conditions threaten safety.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.question_text: What roadway literacy check must you clear before your Arizona road test rolls out?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.teaching_text: Examiners verify you understand Arizona road signs before putting you into live street traffic.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.question_text: Which spoken English driving commands and cabin checks must you follow for the Arizona road test?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.teaching_text: You must respond to spoken English prompts covering stops, lane changes, turns, buckling up, and speedometer function.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.question_text: How does the timing of Arizona's sign and spoken-English check differ from route grading?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.teaching_text: Clearing sign recognition and English prompts happens Curbside before rolling onto the graded traffic route.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.question_text: What does the MVD examiner do inside your car during the road test, and what two dimensions are graded?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.teaching_text: Passing requires both crisp execution on individual turns and calm overall safety across varied traffic.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.question_text: Who provides the Arizona road-test car, and which seven mechanical, glass, mirror, and tire items must pass?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.teaching_text: Arriving with a silent horn, cracked glass, bald tire, or dead signal cancels your road drive at inspection.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.question_text: Will an Arizona examiner accept a road-test car missing one rearview mirror or sporting a small windshield crack?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.teaching_text: Inspectors enforce both inside and outside mirrors plus a completely uncracked windshield with zero exceptions.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: What does Arizona require regarding missing or defective gear—and which five controls, gauges, and alerts must work?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Driving with missing or broken safety hardware—from dead flashers to a broken speedometer—violates equipment rules.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: What condition must your windshield, tires, seat belts, and two front side windows meet?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Intact front glass, healthy tread, working belts, and roll-down front windows keep vision and hand-signal options clear.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: Which three cockpit adjustments belong BEFORE you start the engine?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Setting seat reach, wheel height, and inside-plus-outside mirrors while parked prevents fumbling once the engine fires.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: Which two mechanical and electrical checks come right before shifting the vehicle into motion?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Confirming firm brake pressure and blinking turn indicators before rolling prevents driveway or first-corner surprises.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: How does Arizona split your cockpit adjustments before starting the engine from your functional check before moving?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: Position seat, wheel, and mirrors before ignition, then confirm working brakes and blinkers before rolling.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: Which three seasonal Arizona weather extremes put extra stress on vehicle tires?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Triple-digit asphalt bakes rubber in July before monsoon downpours and Flagstaff ice test tread grip.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: What cost-free step does the Arizona manual recommend as the best way to verify tire readiness?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Many tire shops check tread wear, sidewall heat cracking, and inflation free before summer or mountain trips.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: How do you place a penny into your lowest tire groove, and what visual result warns you need new tires?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Seeing all of Abraham Lincoln's head uncovered in a shallow tread groove warns wet grip is worn out.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: What restraint must every front-seat occupant wear while moving—including in older seats equipped only with lap belts?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Every moving front occupant must wear the installed lap-and-shoulder combo—or the lap belt alone where factory-equipped.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: If a seating position was built with only a lap belt and no shoulder strap, what rule applies in motion?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Missing a shoulder strap never excuses riding unbuckled—snugly fasten the installed lap belt.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: For vehicles manufactured after which year must every front-seat occupant ride belted and adjusted?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: Cars built after nineteen seventy-two came factory-fitted with front restraints that Arizona requires front riders to wear.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: Up to what passenger birthday is the driver legally responsible for making sure riders buckle up?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: If an unbuckled fourteen-year-old rides in back, the ticket lands squarely on the driver.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: How does Arizona's front-seat belt mandate differ in reach from the driver's under-sixteen belt duty?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Front seats require belts regardless of age, whereas the driver's enforcement duty covers everyone under sixteen in any row.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: How does a lap-and-shoulder belt lower severe crash trauma, and what specific job does the lap strap do?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: Being thrown through a window multiplies fatality odds, and the low hip strap anchors you inside the cabin.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.question_text: Which parts of your body—and which cabin surfaces—does the diagonal shoulder belt protect against?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.teaching_text: Restraining your upper torso stops violent forward slams into the steering column, dash, or glass.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: How do the lap portion and shoulder portion divide crash protection across your body?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Skipping either strap leaves half your body unguarded—hips stay anchored while chest and head stay off the glass.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: In older cars with motorized automatic shoulder straps, what manual step remains critical?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Riding behind a motorized shoulder strap without clicking the manual lap belt lets you submarine forward in a crash.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: Why aren't regular seat belts safe for small children, and what does Arizona mandate under age five?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Adult belts ride across soft abdomens and necks, making proper child seats mandatory under five on state highways.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: Until what height milestone must children aged five through eight continue riding in a child restraint?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Booster seats lift five-to-eight-year-olds until four-foot-nine lets adult lap and shoulder belts fit bone structure.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: How does Arizona's child-restraint rule for kids under five differ from kids aged five through eight?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Under five has no height shortcut, whereas ages five through eight graduate once reaching four feet nine inches.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: What does Arizona require when transporting multiple children under eight in a limited cabin space?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: Cabin width and total passenger headcount determine how many child seats can reasonably fit side by side.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: Does Arizona set a rigid numeric seat quota when carrying several children under eight, or a space-based standard?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Rather than quoting a flat seat count, state law judges compliance by cabin room and passenger headcount.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: Which federal safety benchmark—and which two instruction manuals—govern installing a child restraint?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: Even a federal-approved car seat fails in a crash unless anchored following both seat-maker and vehicle-maker directions.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: Through what age should children never ride in the front passenger seat—and why?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: Front airbags inflate at adult chest height and strike children twelve and under around the head and neck.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: How does Arizona's booster-seat age ceiling compare with its keep-out-of-the-front-seat airbag age?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Graduating out of a booster after eight does not clear front-row seating—kids stay in back through twelve.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: What safety step must you take in a pickup or two-seater if a child has no choice except riding up front?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: Deactivating the passenger-side airbag with the vehicle's shutoff switch eliminates explosive front-bag force.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: Which three details does the Arizona manual ask motorists to report to the child-safety hotline when spotting an unbuckled child?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Sharing the plate number, city, and where the unrestrained child sits lets safety outreach follow up.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: Which state office—and website—serves as Arizona's contact point for highway safety information?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: Drivers seeking child-seat or highway safety resources can check the Governor's Office of Highway Safety at azgohs dot gov.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: When is Arizona's five-one-one travel phone line open, and which four core travel topics does it cover?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Calling five-one-one day or night checks live highway closures, traffic jams, public transit, and airport updates before driving.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: Beyond closures, transit, and airports, which three regional or trip topics does five-one-one report?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Checking metro quick summaries and active construction zones before leaving helps you route around orange-cone backups.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: How do you switch a five-one-one call to touch-tone keypad mode—or make voice prompts work cleanly?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: Pressing star switches straight to keypad buttons, while voice control needs quiet cabin air after the full intro.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: Which website mirrors Arizona's five-one-one phone reports, who runs both, and what do they charge?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: ADOT runs both the phone line and az five-one-one dot com free of charge for pre-trip planning.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: How much does ADOT charge motorists to check five-one-one by phone or at az511.com?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: Checking monsoon closures or mountain snow alerts costs zero dollars whether you dial or check online.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: Who holds responsibility for vehicle roadworthiness, and how does skipping upkeep hit your wallet?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Putting off routine service leaves you legally responsible for an unsafe car and triggers pricier breakdowns.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: What split-second advantage does a well-maintained vehicle give you in traffic?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Crisp brakes, fresh tires, and tight steering buy extra stopping or dodging room when surprises unfold.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: Where do you find your vehicle's factory maintenance schedule, and who performs those tasks?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Following the owner's manual separates quick driveway fluid checks from deeper service needing a qualified mechanic.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: How many days do you get to repair your vehicle and return for a follow-up re-check after failing emissions?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: Repairing the fault and returning within thirty days completes your follow-up emissions re-inspection.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: What window opens the day your car fails an authorized Arizona emissions inspection?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Waiting past thirty days after a failed test misses the standard follow-up re-check window.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: Under Arizona statute twenty-eight ten-ninety-eight A, what standard governs anything hauled in or on a vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: Loose gravel, untied mattresses, or dripping fluids flying off a truck bed create deadly highway shrapnel.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: Does Arizona's secured-cargo law stop only big items falling off on freeways, or cover sifting and leaking on any street?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Every street, highway, and roadway is covered, whether cargo tumbles out, blows away as dust, or leaks.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: Which two separate braking systems must every passenger car and truck carry in good working order?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Your hydraulic foot pedal stops daily motion while the independent parking brake holds hills and backs emergencies.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: At minimum, how many wheels must each car or truck brake system grip—and how many brakes must a motorcycle have?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: Both your service brake and parking brake must act on at least two wheels, whereas motorcycles require one.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: How do Arizona's minimum brake-system and wheel rules contrast between cars-and-trucks and motorcycles?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Cars and trucks need two separate two-wheel brake systems, whereas a motorcycle needs one hand- or foot-worked brake.

sec06-card-sec06-F01.question_text: How far ahead should moving eyes read the road in town, and what trap does that prevent?
sec06-card-sec06-F01.teaching_text: Spotting double-parked vans or red lights a block early prevents last-second swerves and slams.

sec06-card-sec06-R03.question_text: Keep Arizona's two road rules separate — what uses 'one city block' versus a count in seconds?
sec06-card-sec06-R03.teaching_text: Visual scanning looks a block downrange, whereas your gap behind the lead bumper uses seconds.

sec06-card-sec06-F02.question_text: Which two directions must you scan before continuing into any intersection?
sec06-card-sec06-F02.teaching_text: Even on a green light, cross-street runners can enter from either side.

sec06-card-sec06-F03.question_text: What two hazards behind your bumper do frequent rearview mirror checks catch early?
sec06-card-sec06-F03.teaching_text: Knowing someone is riding your bumper lets you brake earlier and gentler ahead.

sec06-card-sec06-F04.question_text: Which mirror check and physical body movement must both happen before changing lanes?
sec06-card-sec06-F04.teaching_text: Side mirrors miss adjacent quarter-panel blind spots until you turn your head.

sec06-card-sec06-F05.question_text: What awareness of surrounding traffic lets you make quick, safe choices when surprises pop up?
sec06-card-sec06-F05.teaching_text: Knowing which side lane is open beforehand saves precious seconds when traffic ahead locks brakes.

sec06-card-sec06-F06.question_text: How do you use a fixed roadside sign or overpass to test whether you are following too closely?
sec06-card-sec06-F06.teaching_text: Passing that shadow or sign post before finishing your count proves you need more room.

sec06-card-sec06-F07.question_text: Roughly how many seconds pass when you count from one-thousand-one to one-thousand-four?
sec06-card-sec06-F07.teaching_text: Saying 'one-thousand' before each digit paces spoken counting closely to real clock seconds.

sec06-card-sec06-R01.question_text: Separate the manual's four-second counting example from the full seconds range recommended for poor conditions?
sec06-card-sec06-R01.teaching_text: Saying one-thousand-four illustrates a four-second count inside the broader three-to-six-second poor-weather cushion.

sec06-card-sec06-F08.question_text: How must your physical following distance change as your driving speed climbs?
sec06-card-sec06-F08.teaching_text: Doubling speed quadruples kinetic energy, stretching the pavement needed to stop safely.

sec06-card-sec06-F09.question_text: When rain, dust, or bad pavement degrades traction, how many seconds should your following cushion span?
sec06-card-sec06-F09.teaching_text: Three bare seconds isn't enough when wet or dusty asphalt stretches braking distance.

sec06-card-sec06-F12.question_text: What happens during your reaction delay at high speed that shrinks your margin for error?
sec06-card-sec06-F12.teaching_text: Before your foot even touches the brake pedal, freeway speed eats up car lengths fast.

sec06-card-sec06-F13.question_text: Which single driving mistake causes the majority of rear-end collisions?
sec06-card-sec06-F13.teaching_text: Tailgating erases your reaction margin the instant red brake lights flare ahead of you.

sec06-card-sec06-F10.question_text: Why does open space around your car matter, and where inside your lane should you ride?
sec06-card-sec06-F10.teaching_text: Centering between stripes gives both you and neighboring cars equal side buffer in emergencies.

sec06-card-sec06-F11.question_text: What two maneuvers must your front and rear space cushions stay big enough to allow?
sec06-card-sec06-F11.teaching_text: Getting boxed in tight bumper-to-bumper leaves zero escape path whenever fast traffic stalls.

sec06-card-sec06-F14.question_text: When sharing a lane with a bicyclist, what minimum side gap and speed adjustment apply?
sec06-card-sec06-F14.teaching_text: Blasting close past handlebars creates wind turbulence that pulls riders toward your mirrors.

sec06-card-sec06-R02.question_text: Contrast the unit used for following cars ahead with the unit used for passing a bicycle?
sec06-card-sec06-R02.teaching_text: Forward gaps scale by time in seconds, while side bike clearance stays at least three feet.

sec06-card-sec06-F15.question_text: Which two smooth habits help the driver behind you maintain a safe following gap?
sec06-card-sec06-F15.teaching_text: Yo-yo throttle changes and late blinkers force trailing drivers into sudden brake taps.

sec06-card-sec06-F16.question_text: If a driver tailgates you closely, how should you adjust speed and forward space — and why?
sec06-card-sec06-F16.teaching_text: Opening a bigger buffer ahead lets you decelerate gently so the tailgater doesn't rear-end you.

sec06-card-sec06-R04.question_text: Why does adding space in front of your own hood protect you from a tailgater behind your trunk?
sec06-card-sec06-R04.teaching_text: Stretching your own stopping distance spares you sudden panic braking that would bring the tailgater into your trunk.

sec06-card-sec06-F17.question_text: When multi-lane traffic makes it safe, what simple move encourages a tailgater to go around you?
sec06-card-sec06-F17.teaching_text: Stepping calmly into an adjacent lane puts aggressive bumper-riders ahead of you instead of behind.

sec06-card-sec06-F18.question_text: Whose safety rides directly on your smoothness whenever you have to stop unexpectedly?
sec06-card-sec06-F18.teaching_text: Every abrupt pedal slam ripples backward down the lane behind your rear bumper.

sec06-card-sec06-F19.question_text: Where do vehicle blind spots sit, and why don't mirrors eliminate them?
sec06-card-sec06-F19.teaching_text: Even well-set glass leaves pockets flanking both rear fenders where whole vehicles disappear.

sec06-card-sec06-F20.question_text: How should you proceed when parked cars, bushes, trees, or buildings block your corner view?
sec06-card-sec06-F20.teaching_text: Edging ahead at a crawl exposes cross traffic before your hood enters live lanes.

sec06-card-sec06-F21.question_text: How do you stay out of neighboring drivers' blind spots — and which narrow two-wheeler needs special care?
sec06-card-sec06-F21.teaching_text: Pacing right beside someone's rear door hides you, and narrow motorcycles vanish even faster.

sec06-card-sec06-F22.question_text: What visibility goal applies to your own car, and why shouldn't you trust mirrors alone?
sec06-card-sec06-F22.teaching_text: Flat mirrors miss narrow motorcycles and side-by-side sedans until you physically turn your head.

sec06-card-sec06-F23.question_text: What physical check confirms the adjacent lane is clear right before you move over?
sec06-card-sec06-F23.teaching_text: A crisp head turn clears the side pocket that flat mirrors leave hidden.

sec06-card-sec06-R05.question_text: Contrast the fix for your own blind spots with the fix for other drivers' blind spots?
sec06-card-sec06-R05.teaching_text: Turning your head clears your flanks, while speeding up or dropping back clears theirs.

sec06-card-sec06-F24.question_text: What two steps apply before pulling onto a street from a side road or private drive?
sec06-card-sec06-F24.teaching_text: Main-road through traffic holds priority over vehicles entering from driveways or side streets.

sec06-card-sec06-F25.question_text: Why shouldn't you pull out in front of an approaching car or motorcycle just because its turn signal is blinking?
sec06-card-sec06-F25.teaching_text: Drivers forget old blinkers on or change their minds, smashing anyone who pulls out early.

sec06-card-sec06-R08.question_text: When waiting to exit a private drive, does an approaching car's turn signal count as a safe gap?
sec06-card-sec06-R08.teaching_text: Stay stopped until either traffic clears completely or that signaling car physically turns.

sec06-card-sec06-F26.question_text: Which five everyday changes of direction call for your turn signals?
sec06-card-sec06-F26.teaching_text: Any lateral move — from leaving a curb to merging or pulling roadside — needs a signal.

sec06-card-sec06-F27.question_text: Why should you signal out of habit even when the street looks completely deserted?
sec06-card-sec06-F27.teaching_text: The cyclist or motorcycle you missed spotting is the exact person saved by your automatic blinker.

sec06-card-sec06-F28.question_text: What does communicating on the road mean for other drivers and pedestrians?
sec06-card-sec06-F28.teaching_text: Early visual cues give walkers and drivers seconds to adjust instead of guessing.

sec06-card-sec06-F29.question_text: At least how many feet — and roughly how many seconds — before a turn must you signal?
sec06-card-sec06-F29.teaching_text: Flipping your lever mid-turn warns nobody; one hundred feet gives trailing cars reaction room.

sec06-card-sec06-R06.question_text: Roughly how many seconds of travel does Arizona's one-hundred-foot turn-signal rule represent?
sec06-card-sec06-R06.teaching_text: Test questions ask either the hundred-foot legal minimum or its four-second rule-of-thumb partner.

sec06-card-sec06-F34.question_text: Which two geometric requirements and what signaling distance does Arizona law set for turns?
sec06-card-sec06-F34.teaching_text: Turning from an improper lane draws a citation even if your blinker went on early.

sec06-card-sec06-F30.question_text: If your driveway or alley sits just beyond an intersection, when should you turn on your signal — and why?
sec06-card-sec06-F30.teaching_text: Signaling before the cross street tricks waiting drivers into pulling out thinking you will turn early.

sec06-card-sec06-R07.question_text: Which specific turn location flips the normal 'signal well ahead' rule so you wait until mid-intersection?
sec06-card-sec06-R07.teaching_text: Holding off until your nose enters the intersection prevents cross traffic from misreading your target.

sec06-card-sec06-F31.question_text: What quick instrument check belongs after every completed lane change or gentle turn?
sec06-card-sec06-F31.teaching_text: Gentle lane shifts rarely trip the steering-wheel cancel cam, leaving misleading blinkers flashing.

sec06-card-sec06-F32.question_text: What does a turn signal give nearby drivers — and what legal right does it NEVER grant you?
sec06-card-sec06-F32.teaching_text: Flipping a blinker on never lets you cut off cars already occupying the target lane.

sec06-card-sec06-F33.question_text: Which combinations of electric lights and arm positions may you use to indicate a turn?
sec06-card-sec06-F33.teaching_text: Bright desert glare or towed loads sometimes make adding a left-arm signal smart.

sec06-card-sec06-F35.question_text: From driveways and alleys to curbs and freeways, list the six moves that always require signaling?
sec06-card-sec06-F35.teaching_text: Pulling away from or toward a curb needs a blinker just like highway merges.

sec06-card-sec06-F36.question_text: When relying on hand signals, what additional non-turning action must you signal beforehand?
sec06-card-sec06-F36.teaching_text: Pointing your left arm straight downward warns trailing drivers whenever you slow or stop abruptly.

sec06-card-sec06-R09.question_text: Which situation appears on the hand-signal requirement list that electric turn blinkers don't handle?
sec06-card-sec06-R09.teaching_text: Brake pedals trigger red brake lamps automatically, whereas hand signaling requires extending your arm down.

sec06-card-sec06-F37.question_text: How do you normally overtake a vehicle or motorcycle traveling in your direction?
sec06-card-sec06-F37.teaching_text: Passing on the left places you inside the overtaken driver's clearest mirror sightline.

sec06-card-sec06-F38.question_text: What must you verify about time, space, and oncoming traffic before pulling out to pass?
sec06-card-sec06-F38.teaching_text: Guessing on tight two-lane gaps forces head-on panics or dangerous last-second squeeze-ins.

sec06-card-sec06-F39.question_text: What mirror sight — paired with a shoulder check and blinker — tells you to return right after passing?
sec06-card-sec06-F39.teaching_text: Waiting until both headlamps show in your center mirror prevents cutting off their bumper.

sec06-card-sec06-R11.question_text: Pinpoint the exact rearview-mirror landmark that confirms safe clearance ahead of a passed vehicle?
sec06-card-sec06-R11.teaching_text: Side mirrors distort distance, whereas seeing the entire grille in your center mirror guarantees room.

sec06-card-sec06-F40.question_text: Do your signaling, clearance, and mirror-return steps change when overtaking slow motorcycles, bicycles, or mopeds?
sec06-card-sec06-F40.teaching_text: Clipping back early in front of a moped or bicycle is even deadlier than cutting off a car.

sec06-card-sec06-F41.question_text: When a driver behind you honks or flashes lights to pass, how must you respond with lane position and speed?
sec06-card-sec06-F41.teaching_text: Speeding up to race a passer traps them head-on in the opposing lane.

sec06-card-sec06-R12.question_text: What pedal response is strictly forbidden whenever another vehicle is overtaking you?
sec06-card-sec06-R12.teaching_text: Holding or easing pace helps the overtaking car clear the opposing lane safely.

sec06-card-sec06-F42.question_text: In which three situations is passing on the right allowed — and which two moves around pavement or left-turners are banned?
sec06-card-sec06-F42.teaching_text: Right passes stay strictly on main pavement past left-turners or on marked two-plus same-way lanes.

sec06-card-sec06-F43.question_text: How many clearly marked lanes in your direction allow passing on the right on an open highway?
sec06-card-sec06-F43.teaching_text: Marked multi-lane highways separate traffic cleanly without forcing anyone onto dirt shoulders.

sec06-card-sec06-R10.question_text: Contrast Arizona's default passing side against what passing on the right requires?
sec06-card-sec06-R10.teaching_text: Right-side overtaking is legal only when safe inside one of the specific statutory scenarios.

sec07-card-sec07-F01.question_text: Is it ever legal to pass another vehicle on the right by driving off the paved or main roadway?
sec07-card-sec07-F01.teaching_text: Dropping tires onto gravel or dirt shoulders to sneak past a left-turner loses traction and strikes pedestrians.

sec07-card-sec07-F02.question_text: Which two center or dividing line patterns forbid crossing to pass?
sec07-card-sec07-F02.teaching_text: Either a double solid barrier or a solid stripe bordering your own lane bars overtaking.

sec07-card-sec07-F03.question_text: When does approaching a curve or hilltop forbid passing even without reading paint?
sec07-card-sec07-F03.teaching_text: Pulling left when a crest or bend hides oncoming headlamps invites unavoidable head-on collisions.

sec07-card-sec07-R02.question_text: Does a blind curve or hilltop ban passing on its own even if lane paint is faded or absent?
sec07-card-sec07-R02.teaching_text: Arizona lists solid lines and blind crests or bends as independent no-passing triggers.

sec07-card-sec07-F04.question_text: Within how many feet of a street intersection or railroad crossing is passing illegal?
sec07-card-sec07-F04.teaching_text: Overtaking inside the final hundred feet hides turning cross-traffic and lowering rail gates.

sec07-card-sec07-F05.question_text: Within how many feet of a view-blocking bridge, tunnel, or underpass is passing forbidden?
sec07-card-sec07-F05.teaching_text: Narrow bridge walls and dark tunnel portals erase escape shoulders and forward sightlines.

sec07-card-sec07-R01.question_text: What single distance unites Arizona's no-passing rule for intersections, rail tracks, and view-blocking bridges or tunnels?
sec07-card-sec07-R01.teaching_text: Remembering one hundred feet answers every structure and crossing no-passing question in Arizona.

sec07-card-sec07-F06.question_text: How does traffic flow through a roundabout intersection?
sec07-card-sec07-F06.teaching_text: Eliminating opposing left turns across a central island keeps traffic flowing smoothly.

sec07-card-sec07-F08.question_text: To which side of the central island must you always steer when entering a roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-F08.teaching_text: Steering right around the center island puts you into counterclockwise one-way flow.

sec07-card-sec07-F07.question_text: Who always holds priority in the crosswalks approaching or leaving a roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-F07.teaching_text: Splitter-island crosswalks sit right before the yield line where drivers often stare left.

sec07-card-sec07-F09.question_text: Besides cars already inside the circle, which arriving vehicles must you also yield to at a roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-F09.teaching_text: Long tractor-trailers and buses straddle extra space on entry, earning simultaneous arrival priority.

sec07-card-sec07-R03.question_text: Combine all three groups that earn your yield as you arrive at a roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-R03.teaching_text: Check crosswalk users first, then wait for both circulating cars and arriving large trucks.

sec07-card-sec07-F14.question_text: Between an approaching car at the yield line and a vehicle already inside the roundabout, who has right-of-way?
sec07-card-sec07-F14.teaching_text: Granting inside cars priority prevents gridlock from backing up the circular roadway.

sec07-card-sec07-F10.question_text: What three planning and lane-selection steps happen as you approach a roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-F10.teaching_text: Choosing the signed lane before the yield line prevents panic lane changes mid-circle.

sec07-card-sec07-F11.question_text: For what miles-per-hour speed band are roundabouts engineered?
sec07-card-sec07-F11.teaching_text: Gentle fifteen-to-twenty curves give everyone time to read gaps and cut crash severity.

sec07-card-sec07-F12.question_text: Once a safe gap lets you enter a roundabout, what stopping rule and lane guide apply?
sec07-card-sec07-F12.teaching_text: Halting mid-circle to wave someone in triggers immediate rear-end collisions behind you.

sec07-card-sec07-R04.question_text: Pair the fifteen-to-twenty approach speed with what you do once rolling inside the roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-R04.teaching_text: Approach slow enough to yield cleanly, then keep rolling smoothly through your exit.

sec07-card-sec07-F13.question_text: What simple, safe fix applies if you miss your intended street inside a roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-F13.teaching_text: Looping around the island again beats jerking across lanes or backing up.

sec07-card-sec07-F15.question_text: What two rules protect your car around large trucks entering or circling a roundabout?
sec07-card-sec07-F15.teaching_text: Long trailers sweep across adjacent curved lanes and truck aprons where cars get pinched.

sec07-card-sec07-F16.question_text: If an emergency vehicle approaches while you are already inside a roundabout, what should you do?
sec07-card-sec07-F16.teaching_text: Stopping inside narrow curved lanes blocks the fire engine unless exiting is impossible.

sec07-card-sec07-R05.question_text: In a roundabout emergency-vehicle encounter, which choice comes first and which is the backup?
sec07-card-sec07-R05.teaching_text: Clearing out of the circle opens the curved lane completely before pulling right.

sec07-card-sec07-F17.question_text: How should pedestrians cross at a roundabout, and which two options do bicyclists have?
sec07-card-sec07-F17.teaching_text: Cyclists either ride through obeying vehicle lane rules or dismount to walk crosswalks.

sec07-card-sec07-F18.question_text: Can you complete a U-turn using a roundabout, and what three-step approach leads into it?
